y-m-44-07.title: Gwada da’awar “idan kololuwar alwatika tana da haɗin lamba cikakkiya, fadin ma lamba cikakkiya ne”.
y-m-44-07.topic: Fadin alwatika daga haɗin ma’aunai da haɗin lambobi cikakku (gwada da’awa ta misalin ƙaryatawa).
y-m-44-07.goal: Fahimci cewa misali guda ba ya tabbatar da da’awar “kullum”, ƙirƙiri misalin ƙaryatawa, sannan gyara da’awar ta zama gaskiya.
y-m-44-07.material: Abokinka 지수 ya ce, “Fadin alwatika mai kololuwa da dukkan haɗin lambobi cikakku kullum lamba cikakkiya ce!” Ba a nuna raka’a ba. Alama: fadin alwatika OAB mai O(0, 0), A(p, q), B(r, s) shi ne |ps − qr| ÷ 2.
y-m-44-07.thinking.0: Gwada da misalai ko faɗaɗa hukunci gaskiya ne.
y-m-44-07.prereq.1: Ilimin baya: lambobi cikakku ma’aurata da marasa ma’aurata, ƙimar absolute, da nemo fadin alwatika daga haɗin ma’aunai (a nan tsarin an bayar da shi a matsayin gaskiya).
y-m-44-07.s.s1.prompt: 지수 ta ce, “Fadin alwatika mai kololuwa da dukkan haɗin lambobi cikakku kullum lamba cikakkiya ce!” 지수 ta gwada da ƙirƙirar OAB mai O(0, 0), A(4, 0), B(0, 3), fadin ya zama 6. Yaya za ka yi hukunci game da maganar 지수 bisa wannan misali guda?
y-m-44-07.s.s1.hint.0: Maimakon O, A, B, zaɓi wasu saitin kololuwa 2 ko 3 masu haɗin lamba cikakkiya, ka nemo fadin.
y-m-44-07.s.s1.hint.1: Canza kololuwar zuwa ƙimomi ƙanƙanta, kamar (0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1).
y-m-44-07.s.s1.o.a: Misali guda ba ya tabbatar da da’awar, saboda haka nemi misalin da bai dace ba.
y-m-44-07.s.s1.r.a: Da’awar “kullum” misali guda marar daidai yana karya ta, komai yawan misalan da suka dace. Neman misalin da bai dace ba ya fi gwada da’awar ƙarfi.
y-m-44-07.s.s1.o.b: Idan aka samu misalai ɗaya ko biyu da suka dace, sai a ɗauki da’awar tabbatacciya.
y-m-44-07.s.s1.r.b: Ko da misalai biyu ko uku sun dace, ba ka gwada “dukkan yanayi” ba tukuna.
y-m-44-07.s.s1.o.c: 6 lamba cikakkiya ce, saboda haka daga misali nan ka tabbatar da da’awar 지수.
y-m-44-07.s.s1.r.c: Misali guda ba ya tabbatar da “kullum”.
y-m-44-07.s.s1.o.d: Akwai sharadin haɗin lambobi cikakku, don haka magana gaskiya ce ba tare da neman misalai ba.
y-m-44-07.s.s1.r.d: Samun sharadi ba ya nufin magana tana aiki a kowane yanayi mai cika sharadin. Dole a gwada wasu yanayi.
y-m-44-07.s.s1.explain: Ba za a tabbatar da magana “kullum tana aiki” ta tattara misalai masu dacewa ba; misali guda da bai dace ba (misalin ƙaryatawa) yana karya ta. Saboda haka neman misalin da bai dace ba ita ce hanya kai tsaye ta gwada da’awar.
y-m-44-07.s.s2.prompt: Fadin alwatika OAB mai O(0, 0), A(p, q), B(r, s) shi ne |ps − qr| ÷ 2. (Karatu: ƙimar absolute ta p ninka s a rage q ninka r, a raba da 2.) Ƙirƙiri alwatika 3 masu kololuwar haɗin lambobi cikakku (daga −9 zuwa 9) amma fadinsu ba lambobi cikakku ba ne; kowanne da fadi dabam. (ƙimomin asali: 3)
y-m-44-07.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi p, q, r, s da dama da za su sa |ps − qr| zama marar ma’aurata. Za ka iya farawa da ƙaramin yanayi inda ƙimar 1 ce.
y-m-44-07.s.s2.hint.1: Bayan ƙirƙirar misali guda, canza lamba guda kawai domin |ps − qr| ya zama wani adadi marar ma’aurata dabam.

y-m-44-02.title: Tashar jirgin drone zuwa hanya: a ina warwarewar ta yi kuskure?
y-m-44-02.topic: Tazara tsakanin maki da layi, da layuka biyu masu daidaito tazara ɗaya
y-m-44-02.goal: Nemo layin da warwarewar tazara tsakanin maki da layi ta yi kuskure, bincika sakamakon ta wata hanya, sannan gano cewa maki masu tazara iri ɗaya suna bangarorin biyu na hanya.
y-m-44-02.material: Tashar drone P tana (1, 5) a kan jirgin coordinate (murabba’i 1=1 km), ma’aunin hanya madaidaiciya l shi ne 3x+4y−30=0. Ɗalibi ya aika warwarewar “mafi ƙarancin tazara daga P zuwa hanya”. [figures: 1, 5, 1, 1, 3, 4, 30, 0]

y-m-44-02.s.s1.prompt: A ƙasa akwai warwarewar mafi ƙarancin tazara daga tashar drone P(1,5) zuwa hanya l:3x+4y−30=0. Zaɓi layin farko da ya yi kuskure. (Murabba’i 1=1 km.) [figures: 1, 5, 3, 4, 30, 0, 1, 1]

y-m-44-02.s.s2.r.b: Wannan dubawa ce mai kyau. Wurin da ya fi kusa da P a hanya shi ne gindin tsayen, saboda haka tazararsa ita ce ƙimar da ake nema daidai.

y-m-44-02.s.s2.o.e: Amsa ta zama lambar rashin ma’ana √7, saboda haka sifar ƙimar ta yi ban mamaki, an yanke cewa warwarewar kuskure ce. [figures: 7]

y-m-44-05.s.s1.r.c: Ko layin ba y = x ba ne, akwai sharuɗɗan da ke tantance maki. Duba wace hanya ce daga cikin biyun take amfani da sharuɗɗan.

y-m-44-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka ware hanyoyin bisa ma’anar nuna a madubi (kusurwar dama da matsakaici). Ka kuma bayyana lokacin da hanyar 하늘 take aiki.

y-m-44-01.s.s1.o.d: Layi ta tashoshin jiragen ruwa A da B
y-m-44-01.s.s1.r.d: Maki a layin AB galibi sun fi kusa da tashar guda. Yi amfani da wasu maki a kai ka kwatanta tazarori biyun.
y-m-44-01.s.s1.explain: Maki masu tazara iri ɗaya da A da B sun haɗa da ba tsakiyar sashen AB (3, 1) kawai ba, har ma da maki nesa kamar (2, 4). Maki waɗannan suna kan layin da ya ratsa tsakiyar AB kuma yake haɗuwa da AB a kusurwar dama (matsakaicin rabin layi mai tsaye da AB). Wannan hasashe ne kawai yanzu; mataki na gaba za ka nemo maki da kanka don gwadawa. [figures: 3, 1, 2, 4]
y-m-44-01.s.s2.prompt: A kan jirgin coordinate, dama (gabas) ita ce x, sama (arewa) kuma y. Tashoshin jiragen ruwa A(0, 0) da B(6, 2) ne, kuma murabba’i 1 yana wakiltar 1 km. Sharudda: ana iya amfani da teku inda x ≥ 0 da y ≥ 0 kawai, wurin yana da tazara iri ɗaya da A da B, kuma bai wuce 10 km daga A ba. Nemo ka shigar da wurare daban-daban guda 3. y-m-44-01.s.s2.hint.0: Idan ka zaɓi wuri, rubuta murabba’in tazarar zuwa A, x²+y², da murabba’in tazarar zuwa B dabam, sannan ka kwatanta ƙimomin.

y-m-44-01.s.s3.prompt: Makin da ka samo suna kan layi ɗaya. Wasu maki da suka yi kama da layi madaidaici ba su isa a ce duk maki irin waɗannan suna layi ba. y-m-44-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa da ta bayyana ra’ayi ɗaya a wani tsari.

y-m-44-04.title: Lokacin da alwatikan da layuka uku suka yi ya ɓace
y-m-44-04.topic: Matsayin layuka uku (haɗuwa wuri ɗaya, daidaito) da sharuddan yin alwatika
y-m-44-04.goal: Bita yanayin da layuka uku ba za su iya yin alwatika ba (daidaito, haɗuwa wuri ɗaya) bisa tsarin bayyana bayanai, sannan taƙaita ƙarshen ga kowace ƙimar k.
y-m-44-04.material: Akwai layuka uku l₁:y=x+1, l₂:y=−x+5, l₃:2x−y=k. k ƙayyadadden lamba ne. Bisa ƙimar k, layukan ukun na iya ko ba za su kewaye alwatika ba. Karanta: l₃ “biyu x a cire y daidai yake da k”. [figures: 1, 5, 2]
y-m-44-04.thinking.2: Nemo yanayi na musamman ka bayyana dalili

y-m-44-04.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayani kan layuka ukun mataki-mataki a kowane mataki. Zaɓi tunani mai ma’ana bisa bayanin zuwa yanzu.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, rubuta wane ɓangare na “sharuddan yin alwatika” sabon bayanin ya canja.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko ya dace a riƙe zaɓin ɗaya ko a canja dalili.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Akwai layuka uku: l₁:y=x+1 (gangara 1), l₂:y=−x+5 (gangara −1), l₃:2x−y=k (gangara 2, k ƙayyadadden lamba ce da ba a kayyade ba tukuna). Gangar layukan ukun duka daban ce, saboda haka babu biyu da suke daidaito. [figures: 1, 1, 5, 1, 2, 2]
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ko wace ƙimar k ce, layukan ukun ba su daidaito. To, shin ko wace k ce layukan ukun za su samar da alwatika?
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Rashin daidaiton layuka sharadi guda ne kawai na yin alwatika. Bisa k, akwai wata hanyar da alwatika ba zai samu ba (layuka ukun sun haɗu wuri ɗaya), saboda haka dole a bincika.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Layukan ukun ba su daidaito, saboda haka alwatika tana samuwa ko wace k ce.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Na yi tunani game da yanayin da layukan ukun suka haɗu wuri guda? Ko ba su daidaito, alwatika na iya ƙin samuwa.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Bisa k alwatika na iya ƙin samuwa, saboda haka dole a ƙara bincike.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka nuna cewa “ba su daidaito” kaɗai ba ya yanke ƙarshen. Abin da ya rage shi ne gano yanayin da ke kawo matsala.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba su daidaito, saboda haka alwatika ba za ta taɓa samuwa ba.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Idan akwai wuraren haɗuwa dabam-dabam 3, waɗannan maki ukun su ne kololuwar alwatika.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Haɗuwar l₁ da l₂ ita ce (2, 3). Saka (2, 3) cikin ma’aunin l₃, 2x − y = k, yana ba 4 − 3 = 1.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Idan k = 1, layukan ukun za su samar da alwatika?
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan k = 1, l₃ ma tana ratsa (2, 3), saboda haka duk wuraren haɗuwa ukun sun taru a maki guda (2, 3). Maki guda ne ya rage maimakon alwatika, don haka alwatika ba ta samuwa.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Haɗuwar (2, 3) tana kan layukan uku, don haka akwai wuraren haɗuwa 3 kuma alwatika tana samuwa.

y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Layukan ukun duka sun zama layi ɗaya, don haka alwatika ba ta samuwa.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Gangaren layukan ukun sun bambanta: 1, −1, 2, saboda haka ba za su taɓa zama layi ɗaya ba.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Layukan ukun sun haɗu a maki guda (2, 3), saboda haka alwatika ba ta samuwa.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka nuna cewa sun haɗu a maki ɗaya, wato wuraren haɗuwa ukun sun haɗu sun zama guda.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.info: A wannan karon k = 3. Haɗuwar l₁ da l₃ ita ce (4, 5), ta l₂ da l₃ kuma (8/3, 7/3), ta l₁ da l₂ kuma (2, 3). Waɗannan maki ukun su ne kololuwar alwatika.

y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka samo fadin daga haɗin ma’aunai na kololuwa ukun.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan yana kama da ninkar bambancin haɗin ma’aunai kai tsaye. Alwatika rabin rectangle ce.
